name: Arithmetic Threshold Encoding
description: Replaces the explicit logical NAND / implication clauses of 2-SAT with a linear inequality over {-1, 1} variables. The inequality acts as a threshold that is violated only when both variables take their "false" states, mathematically mimicking a 2-SAT clause while visually appearing as an Integer Linear Programming constraint. This forces models to deduce the boolean structure rather than triggering surface-level pattern matching.
